user_query: My company is launching a new product with a focus on sustainability. Can you provide me with the year's top articles from the dev.to website to gather some inspiration for our marketing campaign? Also, fetch all the climate change news to stay informed about the latest developments.

TaskList.description: Fetch the top articles from the dev.to website related to sustainability for the year.
Fetch the latest news articles on climate change from a relevant news API.
